project_requirements_traceability.evaluation_framework: Evaluation of Guardian Alpha across 14 canonical system requirements.

requirements.name: Competition Entry Contract
requirements.description: agent.py implements decide(market_state, portfolio_state, cash) with pure standard library.
requirements.evidence: agent.py verified, clears preview.py admission checks in ~1.2s.

requirements.name: Frozen Universe Isolation
requirements.description: Trades only approved sector ETFs in universe.json (10 sector ETFs + SPY).
requirements.evidence: universe.json LF hash matched; agent.py restricts orders to RISK_CANDIDATES.

requirements.name: Warmup Processing
requirements.description: Successfully processes 200+ historical bars without crashing or buffer overflows.
requirements.evidence: Synthetic harness verified 220-bar warmup sequence cleanly.

requirements.name: Evaluation Horizon Management
requirements.description: Maintains state across 60-day evaluation window without memory leakage or state drift.
requirements.evidence: Synthetic harness verified 60-day evaluation window with 125 executed trades.

requirements.name: Allowed Data Integrity
requirements.description: Uses only provided daily OHLCV bars; zero unauthorized web lookups or LLM queries.
requirements.evidence: agent.py has zero network imports, zero LLM dependencies.

requirements.name: Causal Chronology & Information Boundary
requirements.description: Decides on T-1 close; executes at T open. No lookahead leakage.
requirements.evidence: preview.py and HardenedCausalEventEngine enforce T-1 close -> T open order fills.

requirements.name: Gross Leverage Cap (1.5x)
requirements.description: Gross beta-adjusted exposure / equity must not exceed 1.50x.
requirements.evidence: preview.py verifies peak gross leverage of 0.94x <= 1.50x.

requirements.name: Position Concentration Breach Gate (<30%)
requirements.description: No single position >= 30% for > 5 consecutive days.

requirements.name: Catastrophic Drawdown Protection (<50%)
requirements.description: Maximum peak-to-trough drawdown must remain below 50.0%.

requirements.name: Portfolio Cash Accounting
requirements.description: Long-only, non-negative cash, accurate transaction cost modeling.
requirements.evidence: Affordance checks prevent negative cash; 5 bps slippage accounted.

requirements.name: Statistical Evaluation Protocol
requirements.description: Rigorous statistical methodology for comparing strategies.
requirements.evidence: Confirmatory joint test failed small-sample size calibration; exploratory protocol fully specified.

requirements.name: Scientific Reproducibility
requirements.description: Cryptographic hashes, deterministic seeds, full evidence trail.
requirements.evidence: 87 committed files, SHA-256 manifests, reproducible random seeds across all tests.

requirements.name: Provider Rights & Licensing
requirements.description: Contractual entitlement for prospective market-data storage and non-display trading.
requirements.evidence: DEC-02 strictly blocked; commercial non-display addenda pending owner action.

requirements.name: Activation Governance
requirements.description: Formal separation of research from prospective trading execution.
requirements.evidence: DEC-06 permanently strictly blocked; zero autonomous activation authority.
